description: Create an edge of any schema type between typed endpoints. Ask for this when you want to link two items with a relationship no typed tool covers — a generic edge of any kind.

from_id.description: The source node; its type is `from_type`.

from_type.description:
Optional since 2026-09-06: resolved from the id when omitted (the id
prefix names the type); an id held by more than one type is REFUSED, never
guessed — pass it then.

to_id.description: The target node; its type is `to_type`.

to_type.description:
Optional since 2026-09-06: resolved from the id when omitted (the id
prefix names the type); an id held by more than one type is REFUSED, never
guessed — pass it then.

name: create_edge
